actions.query: prior evidence for workspace contents, video/transcript acquisition, or extracted moves
visible files in /app and likely artifacts related to transcript or solution

contract.objective: Create /app/solution.txt containing every move input by the Zork player in the referenced YouTube video, one move per line, accurately transcribed from the video/audio/text.
required_behaviors: Obtain the video or a transcript/source for the referenced YouTube video
Extract the player's input moves in order
Write each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt
known_invalid_patterns: Only creating a placeholder or empty file
Using file existence or non-empty output as the sole evidence of success
Producing a summary instead of the exact move list
Missing moves, reordering moves, or adding commentary to solution.txt
verification_plan: Inspect receipts and workspace for any cached transcript or prior extraction
If needed, acquire the video/transcript source and derive the move list
Verify the file contents against the source transcript/video evidence
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence showing the source transcript/video or extracted move list
Receipt-backed evidence showing /app/solution.txt was written with the move list
Receipt-backed evidence that the written contents match the extracted moves in order
